reviews.text: Very helpful and knowledgeable groomer/owner. My dog seemed to get VIP treatment and came out with a classy cut and happy.

Owner is super nice and has a great understanding of dogs that I haven't seen from anyone else. My dog is quite a nervous one and low energy and him and his team are able to take of my pup just as well as the high energy ones. He also gives great tips on how to take care of them and lets you know of anything he sees off with them, which I find really helpful since I am a first-time dog owner.
Seems like a nice place, and a nice guy. He tries.
Used to take my dog Maya there when I lived in the city and she loved it, she used to drag me down the street just to get there. Tim and staff is great and communicates very well. Highly recommend

10/10 my HIGH energy puppy has been going here for last 7 months and they are wonderful. The owner is super hands on and always responds to your calls and texts immediately, the grooming team is amazing, so patient with my dog. best decision to send her here after doing my research.
Tim is fantastic. My pup loves him.
Our dog loves it here and we know he’s well taken care of.

My dog Gemma is a 2.5 yr old border collie lab shep mix.  She loves it. I’ve done the daycare search a couple times now. After doing some googling and looking at other places my brother told me about, I came across Dog Dayzzz.  Read the reviews and looked through the instagram. Immediately applied. It was only one we applied for out of the 10 that I looked at. Tim got back to me immediately. In a couple hours we had connected and scheduled the first meeting. The owner Tim made me feel so comfortable and he’s very understanding of dogs. After talking with him and spending some time in the daycare I would recommend for anyone with high energy dog that is well socialized.  The environment for dogs is play play play with supervision. There’s a lot of big dogs that go there. There is a small play room too and outdoor space. Gemma comes homes everyday eats and goes straight to sleep. She’s very excited to walk there in the morning.  She really likes it. They have an app that is really easy to navigate for immunizations, chats, and scheduling. I messed up my login and Tim was very patient and kind about it. They take measures to keep the dogs safe too.  The place is clean. They sanitize. Gemma comes home smelling fine. Other daycares we used before sometime she comes home smelling super rank. The prices are on par with the other places.  Unlimited monthly is actually a little cheaper.  He’s really created a place for his dog to play and be safe everyday. So it translates to all the dogs that attend his daycare. The staff are polite, patient, gentle with the dogs. Very low stress picking up and dropping off. There’s an Instagram too they post about the day. The place is very thought out and thoughtful for dog behaviors and the neighborhood. The little things they do shows how they pay attention to and try to improve to make sure the environment and vibe stays relaxed. The vetting process is also very personal to your dog.  He’s very engaging about the process.  The vetting can be nervous. He’s tries to make it as safe as possible while trying to get a real feel for if your dog will fit in.  I love it for Gemma. I’m grateful it’s so close to where I am.

Scarlett, my 1 year old Siberian husky just started going to Dog Dayzzz a few weeks ago. I can not say enough amazing things about this facility, the staff, and the owner.
They have their own dedicated app where you can communicate via chat, upload vaccines, book and more.
The price of this doggy daycare is extremely fair and reasonable in comparison to others in the area.
Scarlett is always SO happy to go, she pulls me into the building, and comes home exhausted.
I also love to check out the instagram, where you can see pictures and videos uploaded daily.
I can feel how loved she is walking in the door, everyone (including her new puppy friends) are always so excited to see her, and it makes me feel so much better dropping her off. Everyone truly loves and cares for your dog!
I seriously can not recommend Dog Dayzzz enough🐾
Thanks for the review Aditya ❤️ Love you guys
My dog loves Dog Dayzzz and is always so pumped to go play. They offer great care and communication, and their prices are the best in the area! Would recommend to everyone.
My pup will surely be attending! Great atmosphere and happy Hounds!
